facts.title: Compliance dates have passed
facts.body: December 3, 2025 for advisers with $1.5B or more in AUM. June 3, 2026 for advisers below that line.

facts.title: Examiners are looking
facts.body: The SEC Division of Examinations named the Reg S-P amendments as an examination focus in its fiscal year 2026 priorities.

facts.title: No certificate, no pass
facts.body: There is no certification and no pass. An exam either finds gaps or it does not.
